subject.title: fix(crestodian): keep onboarding connected through restart

question: Should the three urgent fixes land together with the broader inference-first onboarding and plugin/runtime contract rewrite, or should the urgent fixes be split into a narrower landing path?
rationale: The branch removes existing macOS workspace/full-page onboarding ownership and changes public plugin/runtime contracts beyond what is required for the three linked defects, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish the intended permanent product boundary.

options.title: Split urgent fixes
options.body: Land restart-safe responses, deterministic handoff, and profile isolation narrowly, then review inference-first onboarding and SDK/runtime changes separately.

options.title: Keep the unified rewrite
options.body: Retain the combined branch after both blockers are fixed and owners explicitly approve its onboarding and plugin-contract upgrade behavior.

options.title: Pause the rewrite
options.body: Keep the linked issues open and pause this branch if the combined upgrade and ownership changes are not currently desired.

recommendation.title: Split urgent fixes
recommendation.body: Land restart-safe responses, deterministic handoff, and profile isolation narrowly, then review inference-first onboarding and SDK/runtime changes separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and have prior merged ownership of the macOS Codex onboarding surface affected by this product-boundary choice.
